package database_test

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql/driver"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"
	"regexp"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"testing"

	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/codec"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/lifecycle"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/orm"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/orm/expr"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/orm/rows"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/database/query"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/fault"
)

type iterationTable struct {
	orm.Table[retrievalFixtureRecord, int]
	Name orm.Text[retrievalFixtureRecord, string]
}
type iterationAlias struct{}
type iterationOther struct{}

type recordIterator struct {
	compile func() (string, []any, error)
	each    func(context.Context, database.Executor, func(retrievalFixtureRecord) error) error
}

func ormIterator[S any](q rows.ReadSource[S, retrievalFixtureRecord]) recordIterator {
	return recordIterator{compile: func() (string, []any, error) {
		s, err := rows.CompileRead(q)
		return s.SQL(), s.Arguments(), err
	}, each: func(ctx context.Context, ex database.Executor, yield func(retrievalFixtureRecord) error) error {
		if err := rows.PreflightRead(ctx, q); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return rows.EachRead(ctx, ex, q, yield)
	}}
}
func legacyIterator(q interface {
	Compile() (query.Statement, error)
	Each(context.Context, database.Executor, func(retrievalFixtureRecord) error) error
}) recordIterator {
	return recordIterator{compile: func() (string, []any, error) { s, err := q.Compile(); return s.SQL(), s.Arguments(), err }, each: q.Each}
}
func recordIterationQuery(api, kind string, factory func(), retrieved func(context.Context, database.Executor, retrievalFixtureRecord) error) recordIterator {
	if api == "legacy" {
		q := query.ForModel(retrievalFixtureDefinition().WithRetrievalHooks(func(context.Context, lifecycle.Observers) (query.RetrievalHooks[retrievalFixtureRecord], error) {
			factory()
			return query.RetrievalHooks[retrievalFixtureRecord]{Retrieved: retrieved}, nil
		}, true))
		if kind == "join" || kind == "cte-join" {
			a, b := query.As[iterationAlias](q, "r"), query.As[iterationOther](q, "s")
			id := query.NewScalarField[query.Alias[iterationAlias, retrievalFixtureRecord]]("r", "id", codec.Signed[int]())
			other := query.NewScalarField[query.Alias[iterationOther, retrievalFixtureRecord]]("s", "id", codec.Signed[int]())
			j := query.InnerJoin(a, b, query.On(id, other))
			selected := query.SelectRecord(j, query.LeftScope(j, a.Scope()))
			if kind == "cte-join" {
				boundary := query.As[iterationAlias](query.CTE("joined", selected), "result")
				return legacyIterator(query.SelectRecord(boundary, boundary.Scope()).Offset(3).Limit(205))
			}
			return legacyIterator(selected.Offset(3).Limit(205))
		}
		if kind == "set" || kind == "union-all" {
			set := query.Union(q, q)
			if kind == "union-all" {
				set = query.UnionAll(q, q)
			}
			return legacyIterator(set.Offset(3).Limit(205))
		}
		var source query.RecordQuerySource[retrievalFixtureRecord] = q
		switch kind {
		case "cte", "ordered":
			source = query.CTE("eligible", q.OrderBy(query.NewTextField[retrievalFixtureRecord]("retrieved_records", "name", codec.String[string]()).Asc()).Limit(231))
		case "recursive":
			source = query.RecursiveCTE("eligible", q, func(self query.RecursiveSelf[retrievalFixtureRecord]) query.RecordQuerySource[retrievalFixtureRecord] {
				return self
			})
		case "distinct":
			source = q.Distinct()
		}
		a := query.As[iterationAlias](source, "r")
		r := query.SelectRecord(a, a.Scope()).Offset(3).Limit(205)
		if kind == "ordered" {
			r = r.OrderBy(query.NewTextField[query.Alias[iterationAlias, retrievalFixtureRecord]](a.Scope().Table(), "name", codec.String[string]()).Desc())
		}
		return legacyIterator(r)
	}
	table := orm.Define("retrieved_records", func(b orm.Builder[retrievalFixtureRecord], m *retrievalFixtureRecord) iterationTable {
		return iterationTable{orm.TableOf(b, &m.ID), orm.TextOf(b, &m.Name)}
	}, orm.WithRetrievalHooks(func() orm.RetrievalHooks[retrievalFixtureRecord] {
		factory()
		return orm.RetrievalHooks[retrievalFixtureRecord]{Retrieved: retrieved}
	}))
	q := table.Query()
	if kind == "join" || kind == "cte-join" {
		a, b := rows.As[iterationAlias](q, "r"), rows.As[iterationOther](q, "s")
		j := rows.InnerJoin(a, b, rows.On(expr.At(rows.Scope(a), table.Key()), expr.At(rows.Scope(b), table.Key())))
		selected := rows.SelectRecord(j, rows.LeftScope(j, rows.Scope(a)))
		if kind == "cte-join" {
			boundary := rows.AsRecord[iterationAlias](rows.CTE("joined", selected), "result")
			return ormIterator(rows.SelectRecord(boundary, rows.Scope(boundary)).Offset(3).Limit(205))
		}
		return ormIterator(selected.Offset(3).Limit(205))
	}
	if kind == "set" || kind == "union-all" {
		set := rows.Union(rows.ModelRecord(q), rows.ModelRecord(q))
		if kind == "union-all" {
			set = rows.UnionAll(rows.ModelRecord(q), rows.ModelRecord(q))
		}
		return ormIterator(rows.ReadSet(set.Offset(3).Limit(205)))
	}
	var source rows.RecordSource[retrievalFixtureRecord] = rows.ModelRecord(q)
	switch kind {
	case "cte", "ordered":
		source = rows.CTE("eligible", rows.ModelRecord(q.OrderBy(table.Name.Asc()).Limit(231)))
	case "recursive":
		source = rows.RecursiveCTE("eligible", rows.ModelRecord(q), func(self rows.RecursiveSelf[retrievalFixtureRecord]) rows.RecordSource[retrievalFixtureRecord] {
			return self
		})
	case "distinct":
		source = rows.RecordOf(rows.Distinct(rows.FromModel(q)))
	}
	a := rows.AsRecord[iterationAlias](source, "r")
	r := rows.SelectRecord(a, rows.Scope(a)).Offset(3).Limit(205)
	if kind == "ordered" {
		r = r.OrderBy(expr.At(rows.Scope(a), table.Name).Desc())
	}
	if kind == "record-adapter" {
		return ormIterator(rows.ReadRecord(r))
	}
	return ormIterator(r)
}

// The retained database/retrieval_dispatch_test.go bounded complete-record test
// and consumer CTE/record/set/recursive/distinct early-stop assertions are the
// oracle. Both APIs use the same executor, decoder values and observable trace.
func TestRecordIterationLegacyParity(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"record", "record-adapter", "join", "cte-join", "union-all", "cte", "ordered", "set", "recursive", "distinct"} {
		t.Run(kind, func(t *testing.T) {
			var beforeSQL []string
			var beforeArgs [][]any
			for _, api := range []string{"legacy", "orm"} {
				t.Run(api, func(t *testing.T) {
					state := &driverState{}
					var sqls []string
					var bindings [][]any
					var sizes, seen []int
					factories, retrieved, keyed := 0, 0, 0
					window := regexp.MustCompile(` LIMIT \$(\d+)(?: OFFSET \$(\d+))?$`)
					seek := regexp.MustCompile(`"id" > \$(\d+)\)`)
					state.query = func(_ context.Context, sql string, args []driver.NamedValue) (driver.Rows, error) {
						sqls = append(sqls, sql)
						var bound []any
						for _, a := range args {
							bound = append(bound, a.Value)
						}
						bindings = append(bindings, bound)
						w := window.FindStringSubmatch(sql)
						if w == nil {
							return nil, errors.New("unbounded model batch")
						}
						n, _ := strconv.Atoi(w[1])
						size := int(args[n-1].Value.(int64))
						offset := 0
						if w[2] != "" {
							n, _ = strconv.Atoi(w[2])
							offset = int(args[n-1].Value.(int64))
						}
						if s := seek.FindStringSubmatch(sql); s != nil {
							n, _ = strconv.Atoi(s[1])
							offset = int(args[n-1].Value.(int64))
							keyed++
						}
						if size > 100 {
							return nil, errors.New("oversized batch")
						}
						values := make([][]driver.Value, size)
						for i := range values {
							id := int64(offset + i + 1)
							if kind == "join" || kind == "cte-join" || kind == "union-all" {
								id = int64((offset+i)/2 + 1)
							}
							values[i] = []driver.Value{id, "stored"}
						}
						sizes = append(sizes, size)
						return &resultRows{state: state, columns: []string{"id", "name"}, values: values}, nil
					}
					db := open(t, state, oneObserverConnection)
					q := recordIterationQuery(api, kind, func() {
						factories++
						if state.rowsClosed.Load() != int64(len(sizes)) {
							t.Error("factory ran with rows open")
						}
					}, func(ctx context.Context, ex database.Executor, _ retrievalFixtureRecord) error {
						retrieved++
						_, err := ex.Exec(ctx, "SELECT 1")
						return err
					})
					sql, args, err := q.compile()
					if err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					sqls = append(sqls, sql)
					bindings = append(bindings, args)
					err = q.each(t.Context(), rowObserverExecutor{db}, func(item retrievalFixtureRecord) error {
						if state.rowsClosed.Load() != int64(len(sizes)) {
							t.Error("delivery ran with rows open")
						}
						seen = append(seen, item.ID)
						return nil
					})
					wantKeyed := 2
					if kind == "ordered" || kind == "join" || kind == "cte-join" || kind == "set" || kind == "union-all" || kind == "recursive" {
						wantKeyed = 0
					}
					first, last := 4, 208
					if kind == "join" || kind == "cte-join" || kind == "union-all" {
						first, last = 2, 104
					}
					if err != nil || !reflect.DeepEqual(sizes, []int{100, 100, 5}) || factories != 3 || retrieved != 205 || len(seen) != 205 || seen[0] != first || seen[204] != last || keyed != wantKeyed {
						t.Fatal(sizes, factories, retrieved, len(seen), keyed, err)
					}
					if db.Stats().Owners != 0 || db.Stats().InUse != 0 {
						t.Fatal("retained connection or callbacks")
					}
					if api == "legacy" {
						captureLegacy(t, "iteration", []any{sqls, bindings})
						beforeSQL = sqls
						beforeArgs = bindings
					} else if !reflect.DeepEqual(sqls, beforeSQL) || !reflect.DeepEqual(bindings, beforeArgs) {
						t.Fatalf("SQL/bindings differ:\n%v\n%v\n%v\n%v", beforeSQL, sqls, beforeArgs, bindings)
					}
				})
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestRecordIterationFailuresReleasePoolAndSession(t *testing.T) {
	for _, kind := range []string{"cte", "set", "recursive"} {
		for _, mode := range []string{"stop", "error-goexit", "format-goexit", "cancel", "panic", "goexit", "scan", "close", "hook", "factory-panic", "factory-goexit", "canceled"} {
			for _, api := range []string{"legacy", "orm"} {
				for _, owner := range []string{"pool", "session"} {
					t.Run(kind+"/"+api+"/"+owner+"/"+mode, func(t *testing.T) {
						var stop error = errors.New("stop record stream")
						if mode == "error-goexit" {
							stop = &iterationErrorGoexit{}
						}
						if mode == "format-goexit" {
							stop = &iterationFormatGoexit{}
						}
						values := [][]driver.Value{{int64(1), "stored"}, {int64(2), "stored"}}
						if mode == "scan" {
							values[1][0] = "invalid"
						}
						state := retrievalFixtureDriver(values)
						// resultRows' existing close hook exposes failure after successful hydration.
						if mode == "close" {
							state.query = func(context.Context, string, []driver.NamedValue) (driver.Rows, error) {
								return &resultRows{state: state, columns: []string{"id", "name"}, values: values, closeError: stop}, nil
							}
						}
						db := open(t, state, oneObserverConnection)
						factories, retrieved, seen := 0, 0, 0
						q := recordIterationQuery(api, kind, func() {
							factories++
							if mode == "factory-panic" {
								panic("private")
							}
							if mode == "factory-goexit" {
								runtime.Goexit()
							}
						}, func(context.Context, database.Executor, retrievalFixtureRecord) error {
							retrieved++
							if mode == "hook" {
								return stop
							}
							return nil
						})
						ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
						defer cancel()
						if mode == "canceled" {
							cancel()
						}
						run := func(ex database.Executor) error {
							err := q.each(ctx, ex, func(retrievalFixtureRecord) error {
								seen++
								switch mode {
								case "stop", "error-goexit", "format-goexit":
									return stop
								case "cancel":
									cancel()
								case "panic":
									panic("private")
								case "goexit":
									runtime.Goexit()
								}
								return nil
							})
							switch mode {
							case "error-goexit", "format-goexit":
								if err != stop || !errors.Is(err, stop) {
									t.Fatal("returned error identity changed")
								}
							case "stop", "close", "hook":
								if !errors.Is(err, stop) {
									t.Fatal(err)
								}
							case "cancel", "canceled":
								if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
									t.Fatal(err)
								}
							case "panic", "goexit", "factory-panic", "factory-goexit":
								if !errors.Is(err, fault.Panicked) {
									t.Fatal(err)
								}
							case "scan":
								if err == nil {
									t.Fatal("scan succeeded")
								}
							default:
								if err != nil {
									t.Fatal(err)
								}
							}
							if mode != "canceled" && state.rowsClosed.Load() != 1 {
								t.Fatal("rows not closed")
							}
							if (mode == "scan" || mode == "close" || mode == "canceled") && (factories != 0 || retrieved != 0 || seen != 0) {
								t.Fatal("partial batch published", factories, retrieved, seen)
							}
							if (mode == "stop" || mode == "error-goexit" || mode == "format-goexit") && (seen != 1 || factories != 1 || retrieved != 2) {
								t.Fatal("early stop changed batch", seen, factories, retrieved)
							}
							_, err = ex.Exec(t.Context(), "SELECT 1")
							return err
						}
						var err error
						if owner == "session" {
							err = db.Session(t.Context(), func(s *database.Session) error { return run(s) })
						} else {
							err = run(db)
						}
						if err != nil || db.Stats().Owners != 0 || db.Stats().InUse != 0 {
							t.Fatal("owner not released", err, db.Stats())
						}
					})
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

// Neither error formatting hook may run while returning a consumer stop error.
type iterationErrorGoexit struct{}

func (*iterationErrorGoexit) Error() string { runtime.Goexit(); return "unreachable" }

type iterationFormatGoexit struct{}

func (*iterationFormatGoexit) Error() string          { return "stop" }
func (*iterationFormatGoexit) Format(fmt.State, rune) { runtime.Goexit() }
